SELECT F_SPLIT(PRDT.IV_COLUMN,'^',1) AS VOUCHER_DIVISION , PODT.LEGACY_PO_NO AS GLOBAL_NUMBER , PODT.RD_DATE AS MISUMI_RECEIVED_DATE , PODT.REF_IF_NO AS PRODUCT_CODE , PODT.BUYER_ITEM_NO AS PRODUCT_CODE_FOR_PO , TO_CHAR(IVDT.INV_QTY) AS QTY , IVDT.INVOICE_DATE AS SUPPLIER_INVOICE_DATE , TO_CHAR(IVDT.UNIT_PRICE) AS PURCHASE_UNIT_PRICE , TO_CHAR(IVDT.ITEM_AMT) AS PURCHASE_AMOUNT , IVDT.INV_NO||IVDT.INV_SEQ AS SUPPLIER_INVOICE_NO , PRDT.ADD_USER_NAME AS DIRECT_SHIP_TO_NAME , F_SPLIT(POHD.DELY_TO_LOCATION,'^',1) AS ZIP_CODE , F_SPLIT(POHD.DELY_TO_LOCATION,'^',2) AS SHIP_TO_ADDRESS_1 , F_SPLIT(POHD.DELY_TO_LOCATION,'^',3) AS SHIP_TO_ADDRESS_2 , F_SPLIT(POHD.DELY_TO_LOCATION,'^',4) AS SHIP_TO_ADDRESS_3 , F_SPLIT(POHD.DELY_TO_LOCATION,'^',5) AS SHIP_TO_ADDRESS_4 , SUBSTR(PODT.REF_PR_NO,2,10) AS REF_PR_NO FROM ICOMIVDT IVDT, ICOMPODT PODT, ICOMPOHD POHD, ICOMPRDT PRDT WHERE IVDT.BUYER = #TARGET# AND IVDT.INV_NO = #KEY_1# AND IVDT.SND_CHK = 'N' AND IVDT.STATUS != 'D' AND IVDT.BUYER = POHD.BUYER AND IVDT.PO_NO = POHD.PO_NO AND IVDT.BUYER = PODT.BUYER AND IVDT.PO_NO = PODT.PO_NO AND IVDT.PO_SEQ= PODT.PO_SEQ AND PODT.BUYER = PRDT.BUYER AND PODT.PR_NO = PRDT.PR_NO AND PODT.PR_SEQ= PRDT.PR_SEQ UNION ALL SELECT F_SPLIT(PRDT.IV_COLUMN,'^',1) AS VOUCHER_DIVISION , PODT.LEGACY_PO_NO AS GLOBAL_NUMBER , PODT.RD_DATE AS MISUMI_RECEIVED_DATE , PODT.REF_IF_NO AS PRODUCT_CODE , PODT.BUYER_ITEM_NO AS PRODUCT_CODE_FOR_PO , TO_CHAR(IVDT.INV_QTY) AS QTY , IVDT.INV_DATE AS SUPPLIER_INVOICE_DATE , TO_CHAR(IVDT.UNIT_PRICE) AS PURCHASE_UNIT_PRICE , TO_CHAR(IVDT.UNIT_AMT) AS PURCHASE_AMOUNT , IVDT.INV_NO||IVDT.INV_SEQ AS SUPPLIER_INVOICE_NO , PRDT.ADD_USER_NAME AS DIRECT_SHIP_TO_NAME , F_SPLIT(POHD.DELY_TO_LOCATION,'^',1) AS ZIP_CODE , F_SPLIT(POHD.DELY_TO_LOCATION,'^',2) AS SHIP_TO_ADDRESS_1 , F_SPLIT(POHD.DELY_TO_LOCATION,'^',3) AS SHIP_TO_ADDRESS_2 , F_SPLIT(POHD.DELY_TO_LOCATION,'^',4) AS SHIP_TO_ADDRESS_3 , F_SPLIT(POHD.DELY_TO_LOCATION,'^',5) AS SHIP_TO_ADDRESS_4 , SUBSTR(PODT.REF_PR_NO,2,10) AS REF_PR_NO FROM WMSIVDT IVDT, ICOMPODT PODT, ICOMPOHD POHD, ICOMPRDT PRDT WHERE IVDT.BUYER = #TARGET# AND IVDT.INV_NO = #KEY_1# AND IVDT.SND_CHK = 'N' AND IVDT.STATUS != 'D' AND IVDT.BUYER = POHD.BUYER AND IVDT.PO_NO = POHD.PO_NO AND IVDT.BUYER = PODT.BUYER AND IVDT.PO_NO = PODT.PO_NO AND IVDT.PO_SEQ= PODT.PO_SEQ AND POHD.PROCESS_TYPE != '0' AND PODT.BUYER = PRDT.BUYER AND PODT.PR_NO = PRDT.PR_NO AND PODT.PR_SEQ= PRDT.PR_SEQ ORDER BY REF_PR_NO, SUPPLIER_INVOICE_NO
